title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Matthew 28: the empty tomb, the angel's message, the women who met Jesus and the command to make disciples of all nations.

questions.text: Who came to see the tomb when the first day of the week began to dawn?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:1 says that after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

answers.text: Joseph of Arimathea and the guards
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
Peter and the other disciples
The eleven disciples of Jesus

questions.text: What did the angel of the Lord do at the tomb?
questions.explanation: An angel of the Lord came down from the sky, rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

answers.text: He rolled the stone away and sat on it
He carried the body out of the tomb
He sealed the door of the tomb
He stood in the door with a sword

questions.text: What happened to the guards for fear of the angel?
questions.explanation: For fear of him the guards shook and became like dead men.

answers.text: They fell asleep at the door
They fled into the city at once
They bowed down and worshiped
They shook and became like dead men

questions.text: What did the angel tell the women about Jesus?
questions.explanation: The angel said that he is not there, for he has risen, just like he said, and invited them to see the place where the Lord was lying.

answers.text: He was carried off by the soldiers
He is still lying in the tomb
He has risen and is not there
He will rise after three more days

questions.text: Where did the angel say the disciples would see Jesus?
questions.explanation: The angel told the women to say that he has risen and goes before them into Galilee, where they will see him.

answers.text: In Galilee
In Jerusalem
In Bethany
In Nazareth

questions.text: How did the women depart from the tomb?
questions.explanation: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring the disciples word.

answers.text: Slowly, in silence
Quickly, with fear and great joy
Weeping and in sorrow
Doubting the angel's words

questions.text: What did Jesus say when he met the women on their way?
questions.explanation: As they went to tell the disciples, Jesus met them and said, "Rejoice!" They took hold of his feet and worshiped him.

answers.text: "Peace be with you!"
"Why do you weep?"
"Follow me!"
"Rejoice!"

questions.text: What were the soldiers paid to say had happened?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and elders gave the soldiers a large amount of silver and told them to say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while they slept.

answers.text: That an earthquake destroyed the tomb
That the governor removed the body
That the disciples stole the body at night
That they had seen an angel

questions.text: What did Jesus say had been given to him?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that all authority has been given to him in heaven and on earth.

answers.text: All authority in heaven and on earth
The keys of the temple in Jerusalem
A throne in the city of David
The kingdoms of all the nations

questions.text: In whose name did Jesus tell them to baptize?
questions.explanation: He told them to go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: The God of Abraham and Isaac
The Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
The Son of Man alone
The Lord of the whole earth
